name: WNBA_R2A_2020_SEED_SEASON_CUSTODY_CONTRACT_V1
purpose: Add one earlier training-only season so the already-frozen PLATT_LOGIT_1D rolling-origin protocol can evaluate five OOS target seasons 2021-2025.

candidate_semantics.ratings: Exact same deterministic basic-boxscore prefix fallback used in R1A4B1/R1A4C: pace=FGA+0.44*FTA-OREB+TOV; offRtg=100*PPG/pace; defRtg=100*oppPPG/pace; netRtg=offRtg-defRtg.
candidate_semantics.prefix_boundary: Two-phase by official date: seal every date-D target from history strictly before D; only afterward may date-D boxscore values enter history for later dates.
candidate_semantics.recent_rating_alias_semantics: recentNetRtg/recentOffRtg/recentDefRtg/recentPace remain aliases of season-to-date values exactly as frozen in R1.
candidate_semantics.injury: OMITTED_BY_PREREGISTERED_CANDIDATE; numeric 0 is feature omission, not a claim of healthy status.
candidate_semantics.manual_adjustment: OMITTED_BY_PREREGISTERED_CANDIDATE; numeric 0 is feature omission, not historical truth.
candidate_semantics.production_model: Call exact frozen predictWNBA(home, away) with the market argument omitted.

2020_bubble_travel_rule.known_regime: 2020 WNBA season was played at a neutral-site bubble rather than normal franchise home arenas.
2020_bubble_travel_rule.rationale: R2A is reconstructing the exact frozen candidate signal family, not claiming physical 2020 travel. Changing travel to factual bubble-zero would create a different signal family and invalidate use of 2020 as seed for the same calibrator.
2020_bubble_travel_rule.away_travel_miles: Haversine from frozen WNBA_ARENAS away-franchise coordinate to home-franchise coordinate

competition_structure_gate.special_event_policy: No game outside the source's regular-season cohort may enter. If metadata exposes an unexpected special event inside the regular category, stop before target values and preregister an exclusion amendment.

forbidden: 2020 target label access before its probability row is frozen
changing Platt method or optimizer after seeing five-fold results
claiming 2020 static franchise distance was real bubble travel
